meta.name: Slum Golf
meta.description:
The journey of one young boy from the Mumbai slums to the annals of golfing glory.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 22 Nov 2023 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Kissa Shuru Productions, Temple Bells Films · Network: Amazon miniTV

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Ameeri Ki Khushboo
videos.overview: Armed with an iron club and dreams in his eyes, Bharat Nagar’s Pawan Nagre aspires to the golfer life. Standing between him and his goals is his family’s poverty, Pawan’s own inhibitions and a name from Pawan’s past - the unapproachable Coach Rane. But will a game of Slum Golf change all this?

videos.title: Tukka
videos.overview: With a pro tournament looming on the golf course, Gaurav needs a caddie and Pawan needs a golfer. Will these two boys from different worlds find a way to work together? Elsewhere, two love stories bloom, and Coach Rane presents Pawan with not one, but two intriguing offers.

videos.title: Sab Share Karne Ka
videos.overview: The pro tournament is here, and it is do or die for both Gaurav and Pawan. As Pawan aims to touch the stars, little does he know the roof over his head could soon be blown away. Is he about to discover the hard way – misery does love company?

videos.title: Neend
videos.overview: Pawan faces one of the toughest choices of his life – slum or golf? Worlds collide as a sleepless Pawan finds a home with Gaurav. But is the grass really greener on the other side?

videos.title: More Money, More Problems
videos.overview: Pawan plays in the caddie tournament, with one aim – break the course record and impress Coach Rane. But the result shocks and surprises Pawan himself – placing him in the biggest crossroads of his life.

videos.title: Mi Pawan Nagre, Golfer
videos.overview: Finally, Pawan has the kit. He has the spikes. Well, he even has the Coach. Then, what will it take for him to feel like a golfer? A tournament in Delhi against new rival Gaurav may just provide the answer.

videos.title: Pressure
videos.overview: Q School, the gateway tournament to becoming a pro golfer. Pawan wants to try, badly. Coach Rane knows he is not ready. Who will prevail, ambition or better sense? Or is there a way to have both?

videos.title: Doubt
videos.overview: It is the day of Q School, and both Pawan and Rane have gone missing. We follow 24 hours in the life of the coach and student, discovering their truths even as they rediscover themselves.
